ClientProfile.title: ClientProfile
ClientProfile.description: Stores client personal, clinical, and role profile records for Sidratu Beauty Therapy Skin Care.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the client or creator.

address.description: Client residential address in Freetown or Sierra Leone.

allergies.description: Known allergies, skin sensitivities, or medical conditions.

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format for clinical age calculation.

quickNotes.description: Admin clinical quick notes for the client record sheet.

role.description: Role-based access control level for the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the client profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the client profile was last updated.

AppointmentRecord.title: AppointmentRecord
AppointmentRecord.description: Stores scheduled client skincare, aesthetics, and dental appointments.

clientId.description: ID of the parent ClientProfile document in /clients/{clientId}.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the client who owns this appointment.

notes.description: Client notes or special requests for the appointment.

consentSignedBy.description: Digital consent signature of the client.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the appointment.

adminRespondedBy.description: Email or identifier of the administrator who responded.

adminRespondedAt.description: Formatted timestamp when the administrator responded.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the appointment was booked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the appointment was last updated.

TreatmentHistoryRecord.title: TreatmentHistoryRecord
TreatmentHistoryRecord.description: Stores completed clinical sessions, therapy logs, specialist notes, and admin responses.

clientId.description: ID of the parent ClientProfile document in /clients/{clientId}.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the client who owns this treatment history log.

dayDateTime.description: Formatted day, date, and time of the clinical session.

ratingOrPayment.description: Post-session feeling rating or secretary payment record.

specialist.description: Name or role of the specialist who performed the session.

notes.description: Client post-session feeling or clinical notes.

adminResponse.description: Official follow-up response from clinic administration.

adminRespondedBy.description: Email of the administrator who responded.

adminRespondedAt.description: Formatted timestamp when the administrator responded.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the treatment history record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the treatment history record was last updated.

AdminRoleRecord.title: AdminRoleRecord
AdminRoleRecord.description: Trusted role registry mapping Firebase Auth UIDs to administrative roles (Owner, Secretary, Security).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin role was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin role was last updated.

/clients/{clientId}.description: Client profile records containing personal and clinical information, isolated to the document owner or clinic administrators.

/appointments/{appointmentId}.description: Client appointment bookings linked to a ClientProfile, accessible only to the owning client or clinic administrators.

/treatmentHistory/{historyId}.description: Client past treatment history logs and clinical responses linked to a ClientProfile, accessible only to the owning client or clinic administrators.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Trusted administrator role lookup collection for RBAC verification.
